objective: One shared backend service for the existing Nori assistant and an independent chat client.
scope: Complete the shared-service migration locally, including compatibility, isolated integration and recovery verification. Production deployment requires a separate request.
repository: Keep core/, web/, chat/ and migration/ in this repository. Extract a shared client package only when both real clients use it.

known_baseline_findings.summary: Existing attachment fixture selects message IDs as upload IDs. Revision journeys also fail. No runtime or existing test assertions changed by preparation.

constraints: Preserve existing assistant record paths, IDs, tasks, pending questions, files and browser profiles.
Preserve current model roles, providers, budgets and instance limits.
Keep production authentication server-side. Conversation IDs and requested modes do not grant permissions.
Fixture results prove client and verifier behavior only.

Keep fixture-only verification isolated from credentials and real providers. Real-provider acceptance runs only through the existing spend wrapper with verified pricing and one stable logical chat ID.
Do not enable CI/CD or deploy production as part of this migration.

phases.title: Establish the regression baseline
phases.deliverable: Run existing unpaid suites on isolated emulators and preserve per-suite evidence.

phases.title: Introduce the service boundary
phases.deliverable: Map current records to a default assistant conversation without moving them. Retain old client routes.

phases.title: Scope independent conversations
phases.deliverable: Scope state, locks, files, events, pending questions and queued work by conversation. Personal memory sharing remains explicit.

phases.title: Add foreground chat execution
phases.deliverable: Stream text, save interrupted replies, then add attachment reading and a read-only tool using shared execution.

phases.title: Connect both clients
phases.deliverable: Replace the chat fixture with the service adapter. Keep presentation in clients and behavior in the service.

phases.title: Rehearse upgrade and rollback
phases.deliverable: Use an additive compatibility release and a rehearsed rollback target. Do not cancel active user tasks to deploy.

baseline_suites.covers: Exact approvals, duplicate writes and restart around external effects
Subtask delivery, parent cancellation and recovery
Event replay, files, results and isolation of assigned uploads

acceptance.assert: All six existing unpaid baseline suites pass with zero skips. A new user conversational journey must also run through the real API before cutover.
acceptance.remaining: Add a bounded unpaid ordinary-conversation regression journey through the compatibility route.

acceptance.assert: Old routes and old data resolve to the same assistant conversation; IDs and pending task questions are preserved.
acceptance.remaining: Seed legacy records and exercise both route versions against the migrated service.

acceptance.assert: Unsigned identity, foreign conversation IDs and client-requested privilege escalation are refused.
acceptance.remaining: Exercise the real proxy and service identity boundary. Loopback fixture checks are insufficient.

acceptance.assert: Concurrent conversations cannot read or cancel each other's messages, files, tasks, questions or events.
acceptance.remaining: Run isolation cases against real scoped storage and tasks; fixture tests cover messages and cancellation only.

acceptance.assert: Captured provider inputs contain only permitted thread context and explicitly shared memory.
acceptance.remaining: Capture deterministic provider requests from the migrated service.

acceptance.assert: Concurrent conversations share existing daily and monthly limits; retries and new conversation IDs cannot reset allowances.
acceptance.remaining: Exercise actual spend admission and unknown-cost handling without paid calls.

acceptance.assert: Ordered text updates recover after disconnect and converge to the saved final or interrupted answer without duplication.
acceptance.remaining: Run the draft streaming journey against the real API, storage and proxy; include process death mid-stream.

acceptance.assert: Stop affects only the specified turn, preserves partial text and records any external action already attempted.
acceptance.remaining: Verify provider cancellation and external-action outcomes in the migrated runtime.

acceptance.assert: A repeated message ID produces one accepted turn; conflicting content is refused.
acceptance.remaining: Repeat the HTTP contract journey across service restarts with real storage.

acceptance.assert: Chat can read an assigned attachment and use a read-only tool; writes require the exact current approval.
acceptance.remaining: Add deterministic tool-backed chat journeys and approval races.

acceptance.assert: Nori runs background work while chat replies; unrelated actions and events stay isolated.
acceptance.remaining: Exercise both clients against the same service instance.

acceptance.assert: Both real clients send, render, reload and cancel correctly at desktop and phone widths.
acceptance.remaining: Replace fixture-only browser evidence with both authenticated clients and the real proxy.

acceptance.assert: API and worker restarts preserve accepted work and waits without repeating external actions or unknown-cost inference.
acceptance.remaining: Kill each process at acceptance, stream, approval and result-publication boundaries.

acceptance.assert: Repeated migration setup preserves record IDs, file hashes, task references and pending approvals.
acceptance.remaining: Build an old-state fixture from supported record formats and compare before/after inventories.

acceptance.assert: The compatible previous release resumes the assistant after new chat writes, preserving chat data and schedules.
acceptance.remaining: Rehearse upgrades and rollback on isolated data; do not restore old data over newer writes.

acceptance.assert: Selected real providers stream and execute the representative authorized tool path within the development spend limits.
acceptance.remaining: Run only through the spend wrapper with verified pricing and one stable logical chat ID.

cutover: Keep legacy assistant paths and identifiers. Add conversation-scoped storage for new chats.
Test old and new client versions against the compatibility release.
Use a compatibility release as rollback target after new-format writes.
Disable the new chat entrypoint on rollback while preserving its stored data.
Wait for running tasks to finish under the existing deployment rules.
Production release requires a separate request and make deploy.
